title: Evaluating Fairness in Large Vision-Language Models Across Diverse Demographic Attributes and Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating recall performance disparities (Group Disparity metric) between perceived male and female demographic groups on image classification tasks using direct and single-choice prompts on the FACET and UTKFace datasets.
Evaluating recall performance disparities across light, medium, and dark skin tone groups on image classification tasks using the FACET dataset.
Evaluating recall performance disparities across young, middle-aged, and older demographic groups on image classification tasks using the FACET dataset.
Evaluating recall performance disparities across White, Black, Asian, and Indian racial groups on visual attribute prediction tasks using the UTKFace dataset.
